title: Tom Lee: This AI boom isn't the 2000 dot-com bubble — at all
author: iprysync
selftext: People keep panicking that the current AI runup is just a repeat of the 2000 crash, but the difference is night and day. Back then you had random cash-burning startups dumping money with zero revenue. Now the big spenders are absolute cash flow monsters like Google, Amazon, Meta and Microsoft. Their AI spending is already hitting 2-2.5% of US GDP, that scale is nuts but it's actually backed by real, sustainable profits. Is it really that unreasonable to think this run has way more legs than everyone expects?
